narrative.text: A blank, solid white rectangular image with no visible graphic content; the original artwork could not be determined from the extracted image.

The logo of the WHO Human Reproduction Programme (HRP), reading "human reproduction programme hrp." in blue and grey lettering, with the tagline "research for impact" beneath it and the co-sponsoring agencies UNDP, UNFPA, UNICEF, WHO and the World Bank listed at the bottom. It appears on the handbook's imprint page among the credits for contributing WHO programmes.

The cover of the WHO publication "WHO guideline: recommendations on digital interventions for health system strengthening," showing the title over an illustration of health workers and a patient seated around a desk with a computer, with the WHO emblem at the bottom. It appears in the Introduction alongside the discussion of that 2019 guideline and its Recommendation 8 on digital tracking of clients' health status and services combined with decision support.

The cover of the WHO SMART Guidelines publication "Digital adaptation kit for tuberculosis: operational requirements for implementing WHO recommendations in digital systems," carrying the "SMART GUIDELINES" banner and the WHO logo. It is one of three example Digital Adaptation Kit (DAK) covers shown where the handbook discusses DAKs as a desk-review resource and reviews what DAKs contain.

The cover of the WHO SMART Guidelines publication "Digital Adaptation Kit for Antenatal Care: operational requirements for implementing WHO recommendations in digital systems," carrying the "SMART GUIDELINES" banner and the WHO and HRP ("research for impact") logos. It is one of three example DAK covers shown where the handbook discusses DAKs as a desk-review resource and reviews what DAKs contain.

The cover of the WHO SMART Guidelines publication "Digital adaptation kit for child health (0-59 months) in humanitarian emergencies: operational requirements for implementing WHO recommendations in digital systems," carrying the "SMART GUIDELINES" banner, icon illustrations of care activities, and the WHO logo. It is one of three example DAK covers shown where the handbook discusses DAKs as a desk-review resource and reviews what DAKs contain.

The cover of "The MAPS Toolkit: mHealth Assessment and Planning for Scale," showing a photograph of a health worker demonstrating a mobile device to a woman holding a child, with the logos of the United Nations Foundation, the Johns Hopkins University Global mHealth Initiative, WHO and HRP ("research for impact") along the bottom. It illustrates the WHO MAPS toolkit referenced in the handbook's discussion of assessing and planning for scale-up.

The cover of "Monitoring and Evaluating Digital Health Interventions: A practical guide to conducting research and assessment," showing a close-up photograph of hands holding a tablet over paper forms on a desk, a row of four colored circles, and the logos of WHO, HRP ("research for impact"), the Johns Hopkins University Global mHealth Initiative and the United Nations Foundation. It illustrates the practical guide cited as reference (99) in the section on monitoring and evaluating progress on objectives.
A printed barcode (EAN/UPC style) encoding the book's ISBN, with the digit string "9789240093362" printed above the bars and "9 789240 093362" printed below, as it appears on the back cover.
